name: Denison University
academic_ranking: Private liberal arts college in Granville, OH (founded 1831). Ranked tied for #34 among National Liberal Arts Colleges (US News 2025). ~2,400 undergraduates, 9:1 student-to-faculty ratio. Selective admissions (~17% acceptance rate for fall 2023). Endowment ~$1.1 billion (2025). QuestBridge partner.
financial_aid: Denison meets 100% of demonstrated financial need and is need-blind for domestic applicants. Awards nearly $70 million in financial aid annually. QuestBridge partner college; meets financial need of admitted students including international students. As an NCAA Division III institution, no athletic scholarships are offered; aid is need-based and merit-based only.
facilities_notes: Softball team plays at the Denison Softball Field on the Granville, OH campus. (denisonbigred.com softball facilities page)
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program competing in the North Coast Athletic Conference (NCAC). Team active on social media (@DenisonSoftball on X, denisonsoftball on Instagram).
notes: Data gathered live 2026-07 from denisonbigred.com softball coaches/roster pages, denison.edu, and Wikipedia. Tuition value reflects the comprehensive cost of attendance figure of $92,400 for the 2026-27 academic year (Wikipedia); a separate tuition-only breakdown was not confirmed from a live official source (denison.edu cost-of-attendance page returned 404). Roster size (18) from the 2027 softball roster page. Coaching staff includes one assistant listed as TBA at time of check.
